id: title:Gilbert09:force nullable on delta columns added via schema evolution

review.reason: P1.F1.H1 explicitly sets nullable=True on warehouse ingestion fields, preventing schema evolution failures during compaction. P1.F2.H1 adds a regression test. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion, not a systemic architectural change.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the implementation and test, but the actual runtime benefit and the specific warehouse connector behavior are not independently verified; the score relies on the provided comments and code comments rather than external adoption or incident data.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test implementation. The request asks to inspect every hunk, but the scoring instructions require a single score per group. I will report observations for P1.F1.H1 as the implementation, and P1.F2.H1 as the test, while noting that a single score cannot be assigned to this mixed chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds explicit nullable=True to new fields during schema evolution, overriding Arrow's inferred nullability.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion to survive compaction when a new column is added mid-stream, preventing the 'Non-nullable column missing from physical schema' failure.

observations.behavior: Adds a test class and assertion checking that a newly added column becomes nullable even if the incoming batch has no nulls, and that subsequent compaction succeeds.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against the production change, verifying the fix handles the specific failure mode described in the comments.
